headline: Biggest drop in 18 years
dek: The President celebrates the biggest weekly drop in gasoline prices in 18 years, and asks why it came after the election. Meanwhile, at a real American kitchen table…

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Biggest drop in gasoline in 18 years. Notice that they waited until after the “Election?” President DJT
original.key: Biggest drop in gasoline in 18 years.
original.context: Posted on 17 November 2026, sharing another user’s post about last week’s fall in pump prices (not quoted here). Steve is a fictional character.

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 18 November 2026 (shown as 11/17/26, 2:09 PM Pacific).

meanwhile.hook: Trump celebrates the biggest drop in gas prices in 18 years. *Meanwhile, at Steve’s house…*
meanwhile.highlight: Biggest drop in gasoline in 18 years.
steve: Biggest drop in eighteen years? Great.
I just filled up. Still seventy-four cents a gallon more than last year.
*My wallet had its biggest drop too.*

fact.text: a gallon: the national average for regular gas in mid-November 2026, up from $3.08 a year earlier (+24%), even after the recent drop.
fact.source: AAA national average gas prices, November 2026 and November 2025
